name: solarmitra
description: SolarMitra — clean-energy & green-finance platform (SANKALP by Satin Finserv — The Climate Edition)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix client install --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
